description:
Tae-Rim, a high school student on the cusp of adulthood, is pondering her future. She laments that she has led such an ordinary life and fears she is destined for a mundane, uneventful existence. Tae-Rim has a friend named Seon-Ho who seems somehow special and mysterious. Seon-Ho, who appears to be good at everything, is kind but difficult to get close to. When Tae-Rim accidentally discovers Seon-Ho’s secret, she becomes entangled in his family history. As she works to resolve the situation, she reflects on and experiences friendship, career choices, family, and love, and in the process, she grows as a person.

(Source: Naver Series, translated)
